q: How does an agrochemical unit in Roha work out CO2 per batch?
title: Roha agrochemical unit: CO2 per batch
short: Total the month's boiler fuel and electricity, then split by steam and power each batch used, from batch records. Add process CO2 if a reaction releases it. Divide by kg produced for each product. A flat split by tonnes hides products that need long distillation or drying.
audience: Agrochemical and specialty chemical units in Roha MIDC

ul: Boiler fuel: coal, briquettes or PNG.
Process CO2 from reactions, if any.

p: Steam hours, reactor and dryer time per batch. These are the fairest basis for splitting utilities.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
